name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: The steps of a wizard: where you are (the switcher's thumb, gliding along the groove), what's done (the checkbox's on look; the groove fills green), what's left (sunk wells), a step with a problem (the invalid ring and its words), a step that waits (the Spinner's ring) and steps you can't reach yet. Panels stay mounted, so going back keeps what was typed; the new one drifts in from the way you went. Horizontal (stacked or inline) or vertical, with the panels in the list.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/stepper.md. SwiftUI: MetalStepper in the MetalUI Swift package.
